describe.description: A large quadrupedal creature is shown in right-facing profile standing on a small patch of dry, sparsely vegetated ground. The body, legs and tail are feline and muscular with short tawny-brown fur, while the head, neck and chest are covered in dense raptor-like feathers and bear a hooked beak and two large outstretched wings on the upper back. The overall coloration is golden-brown and tan with darker brown on the wing tips, chest and tail tuft and cream patches on the neck and chest. Both wings are fully spread upward and outward, the four sturdy legs end in large clawed paws on the ground, and a long slender tail with a dark tuft hangs down behind.

describe.description: A large four-legged creature stands in side view facing right, combining bird and mammal features. The front including the head, hooked beak, fierce yellow eye, feathered neck and chest, and two large raised and spread wings resembles a golden-brown eagle, while the mid-body, four muscular limbs ending in clawed paws, and long slender tail ending in a dark tuft are covered in short tawny fur like a lioness. It stands on all four paws on a small patch of bare ground with sparse grass, wings held up and open.
